A '''conflict''', occurring in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] on the Forest [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was between the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] and the [[Phlog/Legends|Phlogs]] of the surrounding area. It was the second time the [[First Phlog crisis|the Phlogs had attacked]] Bright Tree Village.
